requirement: A named business owner is assigned for all AI outputs and decisions
An escalation path exists for AI output disputes or errors
AI outputs can be explained in plain language to affected parties
An audit trail exists for all AI-influenced decisions
Bias testing has been conducted across protected characteristics
No proxy variables for protected characteristics are used in the model
Training data has been reviewed for quality and representativeness
Customer data handling complies with PDPL requirements
Model risk classification has been completed per internal MRM policy
A retraining and monitoring schedule is defined
A fallback procedure exists for when the AI component is unavailable
Performance thresholds and alerting are configured
SAMA operational risk expectations are addressed in the deployment plan
Board or senior management approval has been obtained for material AI use
Vendor due diligence has been completed for any third-party AI components
